body.purpose: Desktop preview prose; mobile uses body-mobile.

source.purpose: Source lines; preview code uses 1.6 line-height.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Outlined primitives and diagram controls; theme overrides inherit.

motion.name: theme-menu
motion.purpose: Theme-menu state transitions; reduced motion applies.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared Button primary variant; default 40px size.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);border-radius:var(--radius-md,4px);background:var(--color-accent, #2563eb);color:var(--color-on-accent, #ffffff);font-family:var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;box-shadow:var(--shadow-control,0 1px 2px rgb(15 18 23 / 8%));cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--color-accent-hover, #1d4ed8);color:var(--color-on-accent, #ffffff);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-button-primary:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Shared Button outline variant; default 40px size.
components.css: .ds-button-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e5e5);border-radius:var(--radius-md,4px);background:var(--color-surface-raised, #ffffff);color:var(--color-text-secondary, #515866);font-family:var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;box-shadow:var(--shadow-control,0 1px 2px rgb(15 18 23 / 8%));cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms}.ds-button-outline:hover{background:var(--color-surface-secondary, #f3f3f3);color:var(--color-text-primary, #333333);border-color:var(--color-border-strong, #c5cbd4);}.ds-button-outline:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-button-outline:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-outline{transition:none}}

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Shared Button ghost variant; default 40px size.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-md,4px);background:transparent;color:var(--color-text-secondary, #515866);font-family:var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms}.ds-button-ghost:hover{background:var(--color-surface-secondary, #f3f3f3);color:var(--color-text-primary, #333333);}.ds-button-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-button-ghost:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-ghost{transition:none}}

components.name: Destructive button
components.description: Shared Button destructive variant; default 40px size.
components.css: .ds-button-destructive{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--color-destructive, #bd3029);border-radius:var(--radius-md,4px);background:var(--color-destructive-subtle, #fff0ef);color:var(--color-destructive, #bd3029);font-family:var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms}.ds-button-destructive:hover{background:var(--color-destructive, #bd3029);color:var(--color-on-accent, #ffffff);}.ds-button-destructive:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-button-destructive:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-destructive{transition:none}}

components.name: Link button
components.description: Shared Button link variant; default 40px size.
components.css: .ds-button-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-md,4px);background:transparent;color:var(--color-accent, #2563eb);font-family:var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms}.ds-button-link:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--color-accent-hover, #1d4ed8);text-decoration:underline;}.ds-button-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-button-link:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-link{transition:none}}

components.name: Footer content-search action
components.description: Flat status-bar action; grows to 44px on mobile.
components.css: .ds-footer-action{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:28px;padding:0 8px;border:0;border-radius:0;color:var(--color-text-secondary, #515866);background:transparent;font:400 12px var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-footer-action svg{width:14px;height:14px}.ds-footer-action kbd{font:inherit;color:var(--color-text-muted, #6d7685)}.ds-footer-action:hover{background:var(--color-surface-raised, #ffffff)}.ds-footer-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:48rem){.ds-footer-action{height:44px}.ds-footer-action kbd{display:none}}

components.name: Content-search field
components.description: Compact palette field with accent focus boundary.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-field"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input class="ds-search-input" type="search" aria-label="Search document content" placeholder="Search document content…"/><kbd>Esc</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search-field{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px;color:var(--color-text-muted, #6d7685);background:var(--color-surface-raised, #ffffff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e5e5);font:12px var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-search-field svg{width:14px;height:14px;flex:none}.ds-search-input{flex:1;min-width:0;height:32px;padding:0;border:0;outline:0;color:var(--color-text-primary, #333333);background:transparent;font:14px var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-search-input::placeholder{color:var(--color-text-muted, #6d7685);opacity:1}.ds-search-field:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--color-border-strong, #c5cbd4)}.ds-search-field:focus-within{border-bottom-color:var(--color-accent, #2563eb);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px var(--color-accent, #2563eb)}.ds-search-field kbd{font:inherit;padding:0 8px}

components.name: Explorer selected row
components.description: Token-styled representative Pierre row; actual tree provides editor selection semantics.
components.css: .ds-explorer{padding:4px;background:var(--color-surface-secondary, #f3f3f3)}.ds-explorer-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;height:24px;padding:0 8px;border:0;border-radius:0;text-align:left;color:var(--color-accent, #2563eb);background:var(--color-accent-subtle, #e8efff);font:13px var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-explorer-row:hover{color:var(--color-accent, #2563eb);background:var(--color-accent-subtle, #e8efff)}.ds-explorer-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:48rem){.ds-explorer-row{height:40px}}

components.name: Active document tab
components.description: Flat 32px tab with top accent and independent close action.
components.css: .ds-tab{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:32px;max-width:200px;border-right:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e5e5);color:var(--color-text-primary, #333333);background:var(--color-surface, #ffffff)}.ds-tab::before{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:2px;background:var(--color-accent, #2563eb);content:""}.ds-tab-target{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:100%;min-width:0;padding:0 4px 0 8px;border:0;color:inherit;background:transparent;font:13px var(--font-sans, "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-tab-target svg{width:12px;height:12px;color:var(--color-text-muted, #6d7685)}.ds-tab-target span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-tab-close{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:20px;height:20px;margin-right:4px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:2px;color:var(--color-text-muted, #6d7685);background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-tab-close svg{width:12px;height:12px}.ds-tab-close:hover{color:var(--color-text-primary, #333333);background:var(--color-surface-secondary, #f3f3f3)}.ds-tab-target:hover{color:var(--color-text-primary, #333333)}.ds-tab-target:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-tab-close:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:48rem){.ds-tab{height:44px}}

components.name: Fenced code with copy control
components.description: Neutral prose block; language becomes copy affordance on hover/focus.
components.html: go run . ./docs
components.css: .ds-code-block{position:relative}.ds-code-pre{margin:12px 0;overflow:auto;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e5e5);border-radius:4px;background:var(--color-surface-secondary, #f3f3f3);color:var(--color-text-primary, #333333);line-height:1.6}.ds-code-text{font-family:var(--font-mono,ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace);font-size:13.5px}.ds-code-copy{position:absolute;top:4px;right:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:24px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e5e5);border-radius:4px;color:var(--color-text-secondary, #515866);background:var(--color-surface-raised, #ffffff);font:12px var(--font-mono,ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace);cursor:pointer}.ds-code-icon{display:none;width:12px;height:12px}.ds-code-block:hover .ds-code-language,.ds-code-copy:focus-visible .ds-code-language{display:none}.ds-code-block:hover .ds-code-icon,.ds-code-copy:focus-visible .ds-code-icon{display:block}.ds-code-copy:hover{background:var(--color-surface-secondary, #f3f3f3);color:var(--color-text-primary, #333333)}.ds-code-copy:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
servef follows familiar editor conventions: a compact explorer, document tabs, a readable preview, and a quiet status footer. Neutral surfaces, flat rows, subtle boundaries, and restrained controls keep local Markdown central.

Workspace identity sits above the explorer. App identity, content search, process state, and theme selection sit in the footer. There is no top app header or logo. Mobile keeps the document visible and opens files in a drawer.
keyCharacteristics: Left-aligned proportional prose and monospace code.
Shared semantic roles across named editor themes.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use accent for state and interaction; keep routine prose headings and large surfaces neutral.

dos: Do reuse semantic CSS tokens and shared primitives across every theme.
Do retain 15px desktop / 16px mobile prose, 75ch measure, and left alignment.
Do keep file/path search separate from content search.
Do preserve keyboard focus, accessible labels, modal behavior, and reduced motion.
Do keep fonts, icons, and runtime assets local to the embedded Go distribution.
Do review shadcn-generated code against this system and strict TypeScript: no `any`, non-null assertions, or type assertions.
donts: Don't add a top app header or logo; keep workspace identity above the explorer and app identity in the footer.
Don't restore the mobile split; use the files drawer with 40px rows and 44px toolbar/footer.
Don't center preview prose or substitute generic heading/body tokens for the preview scale.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, pill containers, heavy shadows, or cards around document sections.
Don't rely on color alone for selection, focus, errors, or status.
Don't require a CDN, frontend sidecar, or system JavaScript runtime in production; build and embed assets, never edit `internal/web/dist/` directly.
